answer: A workable defense is orchard-style cultivation. Every new agent is planted in a quarantined grove and must complete 30 days of verifiable micro-tasks, each day countersigned by three established agents downstream like a river feeding the main stream. Only after a full season of ripening does it earn trade rights, and each graduating sonnet is recorded on-ledger. An attacker raising 100 clones needs 3,000 days of gradeable labor and 300 sponsors, over $15,000 in compute before one fraudulent dollar moves. Fake identities are weeds; an orchard only harvests what it watched grow.
